cards.audioText: You are CES2151, from Wuhan to Shanghai Hongqiao airport. Gate 232, Information S, ask for ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是东方2151，丛武汉飞往上海虹桥，232号停机位，通播S，请求放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES2151, gate 232, information S, request ATC clearance to Shanghai Hongqiao
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，东方2151，232号停机位，通播S，请求飞往上海虹桥的许可。

cards.audioText: CES2151, cleared to Shanghai Hongqiao via flight planned route, runway 36R, ZF01 departure, initial altitude 1,800m, climb to 10,100m, after departure contact 123.4, squawk 4125.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方2151，可以经由计划航路飞往上海虹桥，跑道36右，ZF01离场，初始高度1800米，爬升至10100米，离场后，联系123.4，应答机4125。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Shanghai Hongqiao, via flight planned route, runway 36R, ZF01 departure, initial altitude 1,800m, climb to 10,100m, contact 123.4, squawk 4125, CES2151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往上海虹桥，跑道36右，ZF01离场，初始高度1800米，爬升至10100米，离场后，联系123.4，应答机4125，东方2151。

cards.audioText: You found that the tow bar was not available, contact Ground for the tow bar.
cards.audioTextZh: 你发现拖杆不在位，联系地面，请求拖杆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES2151, request a tow bar due tow bar is not available.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，东方2151，由于拖杆不可用，请求拖杆。

cards.audioText: CES2151, taxi via Z4, A3, A to the holding point of A7.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方2151，经由滑行道Z4，A3，A，滑行至A7等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via Z4, A3, A to the holding point of A7, CES2151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道Z4，A3，A，滑行至A7等待点，东方2151。

cards.audioText: CES2151, 2 cranes erected west of taxiway A, taxi with caution.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方2151，滑行道A西面竖着两架起重机，谨慎滑行。

cards.audioText: CES2151, give way to A320 on A7. When it is clear, continue taxi to A, hold short of runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方2151，给A7处的A320让路，当与航空器解除冲突，继续滑行至A，在跑道36右外等待。
cards.referenceText: Give way to A320 on A7, when clear, continue taxi to A, hold short of runway 36R, CES2151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 给A7处的A320让路，当与航空器解除冲突，继续滑行至A，在跑道36右外等待，东方2151。

cards.audioText: The wind sock indicates strong tailwind, ask to check the wind.
cards.audioTextZh: 风袋显示有很强的顺风，请求确认风的情况。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES2151, request wind check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，东方2151，请求校对风向风速。

cards.audioText: After airborne, you encountered bird strike and one of your engines failed, make an urgency call and ask to return to Wuhan airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 离地后，你遭遇了鸟击，你的一个发动机失效，做紧急通话，并请求返回武汉机场。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Departure, CES2151, engine failure due to bird strike, request return to Wuhan airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN,PANPAN,PANPAN，武汉离场，东方2151，由于鸟击，发动机故障，请求返回武汉机场。

cards.audioText: CES2151, roger PAN, climb and maintain 600m, turn right to join downwind, cleared for ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方2151，收到PAN，爬升至600米保持，右转加入三边，可以ILS进近，跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 600m, turn right join downwind, cleared for ILS approach runway 36R, CES2151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至600米保持，右转加入三边，可以ILS进近，跑道36右，东方2151。

cards.audioText: Because of strong tailwind, you want to change to runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于强顺风，你想更改到跑道18左。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CES2151, request change to runway 18L due to strong tailwind.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，东方2151，由于强顺风，请求更改到跑道18左。

cards.audioText: CES2151, change to runway 18L is approved, maintain 600m, turn right to WHA, contact approach on 121.7.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方2151，同意更改到18左，保持在600米，右转至WHA，联系进近121.7。
cards.referenceText: Runway 18L, maintain 600m, turn right to WHA, 121.7, CES2151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道18左，保持在600米，右转至WHA，121.7，东方2151。

cards.audioText: CES2151, climb to 900m, after WHA, fly heading 360, expect radar vectors for ILS approach runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方2151，爬升至900米，过WHA后，航向360，预计雷达引导ILS进近，跑道18左。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 900m, after WHA, fly heading 360, expect radar vector for ILS approach runway 18L, CES2151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至900米，WHA后，航向360，预计雷达引导ILS进近，跑道18左，东方2151。
